_note: SYNTHETIC DATA. Every post and comment here was written by hand for prototyping the sentiment meter. None of it was collected from Facebook and none of it reflects real public reactions. Each comment carries the label a human reviewer would give, so the file doubles as a small check of classifier agreement.

posts.gist: Most commenters were frustrated that interruptions keep happening and asked for more notice and water deliveries, while a few thanked crews for the repairs.

posts.message: TRAFFIC ADVISORY: Starting Monday, a new one-way traffic scheme will be implemented on selected downtown streets on a trial basis for 30 days. Motorists are advised to follow signages and traffic enforcers. Public feedback is welcome.
posts.gist: Commenters were split: some welcomed the trial and reported smoother downtown traffic, while others said it moved congestion to side streets and lengthened jeepney routes.

posts.message: THANK YOU, VOLUNTEERS! Over 600 residents, students, and barangay workers joined this weekend's clean-up drive around the lake and nearby creeks, collecting several tons of waste. Let us keep our city clean together.
posts.gist: Commenters overwhelmingly praised the volunteers and the turnout, with a few asking for more trash bins and stricter enforcement against littering.
